title: Add Cookie Consent
content: Create cookie banner. Container: fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-50 p-4 bg-white shadow-lg border-t. Content: max-w-4xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4. Text: text-sm text-gray-600, brief explanation with privacy policy link. Buttons: flex gap-2, Reject (outline), Accept (primary). Animation: slide up on mount.

variants.simple: Create GDPR cookie consent banner with accept/reject.
variants.detailed: Create cookie banner. Container: fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-50 p-4 bg-white shadow-lg border-t. Content: max-w-4xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4. Text: text-sm text-gray-600, brief explanation with privacy policy link. Buttons: flex gap-2, Reject (outline), Accept (primary). Animation: slide up on mount.
variants.advanced: Create complete cookie consent system. Banner position: bottom bar (default), bottom corner popup, or center modal. Initial state: show on first visit, respect Do Not Track if enabled. Content: clear explanation of cookie usage, link to full privacy policy. Cookie categories: essential (always on), analytics, marketing, preferences - each with toggle and description. Quick actions: "Accept All", "Reject All", "Customize" buttons. Customization modal: detailed category explanations, individual toggles, Save Preferences button. Essential cookies: cannot be disabled, explain why. Cookie list: expandable list of actual cookies per category with purpose and duration. Remember choice: store preference in cookie/localStorage, expiry after 1 year. Re-consent: trigger on policy change, show "Updated" badge. Minimize: after choice, show small button to reopen preferences. Legal compliance: GDPR (EU), CCPA (California) option switches, appropriate language. A/B variants: different copy and layouts for testing. No banner if consented: only show settings link in footer. Integration: fire consent events for analytics tools to respect. Accessibility: focus trap in modal, keyboard operable, screen reader announcements.
